description: Renovate rules shared by every app built from the swhurl template. Apps extend this file (github>samclement/swhurl-app-template-typescript:renovate-preset), so a change here reaches all of them on Renovate's next run.

packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry packages release together; update them in one PR.

Minor, patch and digest updates merge themselves once every check passes (type-check, tests, image build, smoke test). Each merge deploys to staging; production changes only through a promote. Apps without tests set automerge to false in their renovate.json.
Major updates wait for a person.
Copier updates can touch app edits; always review their complete diff and conflicts.
